title: IP Camera Testing — ONVIF Discovery, RTSP Stream Access, and Unauthenticated View
goal: Discover IP cameras on the network via ONVIF, test whether RTSP streams are accessible without credentials, and check camera management interfaces for default credentials and unauthenticated access.
scope: Create workers/runners/camera_test/runner.py: (1) ONVIF DISCOVERY: send WS-Discovery probe (UDP multicast to 239.255.255.250:3702 with SOAP envelope) to find ONVIF-compatible devices. Parse ProbeMatch responses for XAddrs (device service URLs). For each found camera: GET /onvif/device_service WSDL, extract device information (manufacturer, model, firmware). Check if GetDeviceInformation is accessible without auth (WS-Security). (2) RTSP STREAM TEST: for each host with port 554 open, test RTSP OPTIONS request (no auth needed for OPTIONS in many cameras). Test common RTSP paths without credentials: rtsp://host/live, /cam, /video, /stream, /h264, /channel1, /Streaming/Channels/1. Use Python opencv or standard socket to send RTSP DESCRIBE request. If 200 OK without auth, create CRITICAL finding: 'RTSP video stream accessible without authentication'. (3) CAMERA WEB INTERFACE: test port 80/8080/443 for camera web UIs. Send requests for common camera web paths: /cgi-bin/viewer/video.jpg, /snapshot.jpg, /image.jpg — if accessible without auth, CRITICAL finding. Test default credentials: admin/admin, admin/12345, admin/password, root/root, admin/empty for HTTP Basic and Digest auth. Add profile active-lan-camera-audit.
generation_reason: User has Unifi cameras on the network. Unauthenticated RTSP access is a common misconfiguration where anyone on the network can view camera feeds. ONVIF is the standard protocol for IP cameras and allows complete control. Neither ONVIF nor RTSP is currently tested.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Read-only access testing. No video frame capture or storage. RTSP test sends OPTIONS and DESCRIBE only (no PLAY/SETUP). No PTZ control. No configuration changes.

success_criteria: ONVIF WS-Discovery finds cameras on the network.
Camera manufacturer and model extracted from ONVIF response.
RTSP stream accessibility tested without credentials.
CRITICAL finding created for unauthenticated RTSP streams.
Camera web interface default credentials tested.

acceptance_criteria: ONVIF discovery works. RTSP accessibility tested. Unauthenticated access findings created.

after_completion: Promote exactly one next approved task into NEXT_TASK.md.
